Method / interpretation: The user-provided URL was used as the inventory source. Page text was captured on 14 Aug 2026 (user timezone).
Parent entries were included. Explicit child names shown under a parent were treated as sub-products or sub-brands. Entries with no child names were represented by a clearly labeled core offering.

Three alternatives were selected from distinct companies and matched to the nearest practical product/service category. The same alternative company may recur across different rows when it is a category-appropriate substitute.

Alternative 1, 2 and 3 companies are different from one another and are not the listed brand for that record. The database does not attempt to map every corporate parent/subsidiary relationship worldwide.

The supplied source page is cited as the inventory source. For alternatives, official company/product landing pages are linked in the Alternatives and Source Inventory sheets. Links are starting points for verification, not endorsements.
Retail availability, formulations, service coverage, regulation, and ownership can vary by country and over time. Verify locally before purchasing.
The source page itself warns against stopping medications. This database does not recommend medication switching and should not be used to alter treatment.
